blurb: Just a ten-minute drive from downtown Boston, the Larz Anderson Auto Museum in Brookline, Massachusetts is a must-visit destination for car enthusiasts, families, and visitors exploring the Boston area. Located in the scenic 64-acre Larz Anderson Park, this classic car museum showcases “America’s Oldest Car Collection” inside the historic Carriage House.
